## 경쟁 바비큐 대회

미국 테네시주 린치버그(Lynchburg)에서 열린 제37회 잭 다니엘스 월드 챔피언십 초청 바비큐(Jack Daniel's World Championship Invitational Barbecue)에서 캐나다 캘거리(Calgary)의 재니스 스멜라(Janice Smella)가 이끄는 스멜라큐(Smellaque) 팀이 1위에 올랐다. 이번이 세 번째 도전이었다. 미국 남부의 성지로 불리는 대회 정상에 국경 너머의 팀이 섰다는 사실은, 경쟁 바비큐가 이미 한 나라의 전통을 넘어 국제 경기로 옮겨 가고 있음을 보여 준다. 원문 보기 : [CTV News](https://www.ctvnews.ca/calgary/article/canadian-pitmaster-takes-home-top-prize-in-prestigious-barbecue-competition-in-tennessee/)

10월 15일부터 18일까지 인디애나폴리스(Indianapolis)에서 열린 월드 푸드 챔피언십(World Food Championships)에는 35개 이상 주와 14개국에서 400개 이상 팀이 참가했고, 상금 총액은 40만 달러를 넘었다. 바비큐 부문은 인디애나주 카멀(Carmel)의 조던 데이비스(Jordan Davis), 라이브 파이어 부문은 네덜란드 위트레흐트(Utrecht)의 아디 멜크만(Adi Melkman)이 우승했다. 버거 부문 우승은 일본 도쿄의 다카노 다테와키(Tatewaki Takano)에게 돌아갔다. 불을 다루는 부문의 정상에 유럽과 아시아의 이름이 오른 것은 이 경기가 미국 안의 축제에서 세계 공통의 종목으로 넓어지는 과정이다. 10개 부문 우승자는 2027년 봄 파이널 테이블(Final Table)에서 최종 타이틀을 겨룬다. 원문 보기 : [PR Newswire](https://www.webull.com/news/15775408026496000)

## 인재 양성

텍사스에서는 고등학생 바비큐 팀들이 주 대회 진출권을 놓고 경쟁을 이어 가고 있다. 템플 고교(Temple High)와 코퍼러스 코브(Copperas Cove)의 팀이 11월 13일 주 대회 진출 소식을 전했다. 학교가 불 앞의 기술을 정식 경쟁의 언어로 가르친다는 것은 프로바비큐어(Pro Barbecuer)가 교육 체계 안에서 길러질 수 있다는 가장 구체적인 증거다. 원문 보기 : [Killeen Daily Herald](https://news.google.?oc=5), [Copperas Cove Leader Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQTXU2eGxubDkzY3ZqeDhWbXZIbGNsWGg2NDY1cEctVU54WmZuaTlVTER0eFNLQW04UGNjVS02ZFFReDlNUldMVFVLR2RldTlnVlk5bEN1WUpublJpNnRsZFlkaHFFQ0tVaWZYWk1RT2UzZ0ZZN1UzbGkwZHJ6WU5NMjBEOEFldHBS?oc=5)

## 바비큐 산업

펠릿 그릴의 대표 기업 트레거(Traeger)는 11월 4일 3분기 실적을 발표했다. 총매출은 40.4% 줄어든 7,470만 달러, 그릴 매출은 48.1% 줄어든 3,970만 달러였다. 경영진은 3분기에서 밀린 출하와 로우스(Lowe's) 매장 확대에 힘입어 4분기에는 매출이 다시 늘어날 것으로 내다봤다. 팬데믹 시기 뒷마당에 쌓였던 장비 수요가 빠지고 난 자리에서, 산업은 기계를 더 파는 일보다 불을 피울 이유를 다시 만드는 일을 고민해야 하는 국면에 들어섰다. 원문 보기 : [Business Wire](https://finviz.com/news/416010/traeger-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-2026-results)

## 아시아

중국의 바비큐 시장은 성장과 정리를 함께 겪고 있다. 홍찬산업연구원(红餐产业研究院)에 따르면 2025년 중국 바비큐(烧烤) 시장 규모는 2,680억 위안으로 4.3% 늘었고, 2026년에는 2,800억 위안을 넘을 것으로 전망된다. 그러나 2026년 2월 기준 매장 수는 40만 9천 곳으로 줄었다. 중국은 세계 바비큐 장비의 주요 생산 기지로, 광둥(广东)과 허난(河南) 등지에 산업 집적지가 형성되어 있다. 내년 5월 광저우(广州) AOBE 2027이 장비 산업의 한복판에서 열리는 이유가 여기서 읽힌다. 원문 보기 : [澎湃新闻](https://m.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_32862655)

한국에서는 가을 축제가 이어졌다. 10월 29일부터 11월 1일까지 홍주성 일원에서 열린 2026 홍성글로벌바비큐페스티벌은 한우와 한돈 할인 판매, 셀프 숯불구이 체험 등을 운영했다. 진안고원 김치보쌈축제에서도 흑돼지 바비큐가 지역 먹거리의 중심에 섰다. 한국의 바비큐 축제가 아직은 축산물 소비 촉진에 무게를 두고 있다면, 그다음 단계는 경쟁과 의례를 갖춘 스포츠바비큐(Sports Barbecue)로 옮겨 가는 일이 될 것이다. 원문 보기 : [경향신문](https://khan.co.kr/article/202610281056001), [메트로신문](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFB5LTYtNlFQSTRwWXlkZk1RVmxfZTJfeHdmVWhlYlhmc3VkZ1NNQjBfaUhOaGN1SXU1RkU4M3VtN0FLNFNPbTVYSUdBelNkSUc1WUhSRXVXWkl0Z2V2bG5VWQ?oc=5)

## 세계 각지

아르헨티나 라팜파(La Pampa)의 아사도르(asador) 대회, 남아프리카공화국의 자선 브라이(braai) 대회, 브라질 리우데자네이루의 슈하스코(churrasco) 축제, 프랑스령 과들루프(Guadeloupe)의 미식 축제가 지난주 잇따라 열렸다. 이름은 달라도 불 앞에 사람을 모으는 방식은 같다. 원문 보기 : [La Montaña Noticias](https://news.google.?oc=5), [The Citizen](https://news.google.?oc=5), [ABIH-RJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNM1ZjLXZaYTI4RDF4NTAtbWtNd0ZjYzZzc0JhUmo3OS03bk5QblhtMmNaaFgxRTR6QjhDY3pneC1ZeWpmNG9IaU5tbUQ0RzExU19CVVdkM1FPZmNDeHdNaUhpT1gwOGJvbnBkbkFZMkdOVlpkYWhVY0wySDRYeUdUR3BLcUdPazllc2toWWEtNVRNUDBqT212dWItU3JJc3dlMWZDVm0weVFHZ0JkY2hwNQ?oc=5), [France-Antilles](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxNcjRDUWlhZEVTR0xwVUN6aEVsMWVWb1JwdTRaNzdxUU91b0RaUzBBUW8wTF9hNV9fNjZxdTJna1g1V3dSdWg1U3FNMExQMWdEVHl3VGo2UjMyS0pZcXh5XzlabUV2Y0hod2ZzOGtUX0NnWnZqYVRnRUZYTk9uVlRwUmRlTVdoX3lxSTV0YWxBbXhLak8zMVM2MnJvQm1FZVc2Wm5mNkFqV3hJc2pfUnpfOXIwS19xbFlwclhkckFRR0lUV0JmdDRsRG1aUHBfUQ?oc=5)

## 학술

남아프리카공화국 원더베르크 동굴(Wonderwerk Cave)에서 약 107만 년에서 179만 년 전 퇴적층에 걸쳐 반복된 불 사용의 흔적이 확인되었다는 연구가 올해 6월 『PLOS One』에 실렸다. 연구진은 불에 탄 뼈가 푸른빛 아래에서 붉게 빛나는 발광 현상을 이용해 그 흔적을 가려냈다. 다만 연구진은 이 뼈들만으로 초기 인류가 일상적으로 요리를 했다고 단정할 수는 없다고 덧붙였다. 화식(火食)의 기원을 호모 에렉투스(Homo erectus)에게서 찾는 관점에 고고학적 연대가 한 걸음 더 다가선 셈이다. 원문 보기 : [Archaeology Magazine](https://archaeologymag.com/2026/06/early-humans-used-fire-in-wonderwerk-cave/)

## Competition barbecue

At the 37th Jack Daniel's World Championship Invitational Barbecue in Lynchburg, Tennessee, the Smellaque team led by Janice Smella of Calgary, Canada, took first place. It was her third attempt. That a team from across the border has stood at the top of the contest known as the holy ground of the American South shows that competition barbecue is already moving beyond a single nation's tradition toward an international sport. Source: [CTV News](https://www.ctvnews.ca/calgary/article/canadian-pitmaster-takes-home-top-prize-in-prestigious-barbecue-competition-in-tennessee/)

The World Food Championships, held in Indianapolis from 15 to 18 October, drew more than 400 teams from over 35 states and 14 countries, with total prize money above 400,000 dollars. Jordan Davis of Carmel, Indiana, won the barbecue category, and Adi Melkman of Utrecht, the Netherlands, won the live fire category. The burger title went to Tatewaki Takano of Tokyo, Japan. European and Asian names at the top of the fire categories mark the passage of this contest from an American festival to a sport shared by the world. The ten category champions will compete for the final title at the Final Table in spring 2027. Source: [PR Newswire](https://www.webull.com/news/15775408026496000)

## Developing talent

In Texas, high school barbecue teams continue to compete for places at the state championship. Teams from Temple High and Copperas Cove announced their qualification on 13 November. When schools teach the craft of the fire in the language of formal competition, it is the most concrete evidence that the Pro Barbecuer can be raised within an educational system. Source: [Killeen Daily Herald](https://news.google.?oc=5), [Copperas Cove Leader Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQTXU2eGxubDkzY3ZqeDhWbXZIbGNsWGg2NDY1cEctVU54WmZuaTlVTER0eFNLQW04UGNjVS02ZFFReDlNUldMVFVLR2RldTlnVlk5bEN1WUpublJpNnRsZFlkaHFFQ0tVaWZYWk1RT2UzZ0ZZN1UzbGkwZHJ6WU5NMjBEOEFldHBS?oc=5)

## Barbecue industry

Traeger, the leading pellet grill maker, reported its third-quarter results on 4 November. Total revenue fell 40.4% to 74.7 million dollars, and grill revenue fell 48.1% to 39.7 million dollars. Management expects revenue to grow again in the fourth quarter, helped by shipments shifted from the third quarter and its expansion at Lowe's. As the equipment demand that piled up in backyards during the pandemic recedes, the industry has entered a phase in which it must think less about selling more machines and more about renewing the reasons to light a fire. Source: [Business Wire](https://finviz.com/news/416010/traeger-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-2026-results)

## Asia

China's barbecue market is growing and consolidating at the same time. According to the Hongcan Industry Research Institute (红餐产业研究院), the Chinese barbecue (烧烤) market reached 268 billion yuan in 2025, up 4.3%, and is expected to exceed 280 billion yuan in 2026. Yet the number of outlets fell to 409,000 as of February 2026. China is a major production base for the world's barbecue equipment, with industrial clusters in Guangdong and Henan. This explains why AOBE 2027 in Guangzhou next May is held at the heart of the equipment industry. Source: [澎湃新闻](https://m.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_32862655)

In Korea, the autumn festivals continued. The 2026 Hongseong Global Barbecue Festival, held around Hongjuseong from 29 October to 1 November, offered discounted Hanwoo beef and Korean pork and self-service charcoal grilling. At the Jinan Highland Kimchi Bossam Festival, black pork barbecue also took centre stage among local foods. If Korean barbecue festivals still lean toward promoting meat consumption, the next step will be a move toward Sports Barbecue with competition and ritual. Source: [경향신문](https://khan.co.kr/article/202610281056001), [메트로신문](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFB5LTYtNlFQSTRwWXlkZk1RVmxfZTJfeHdmVWhlYlhmc3VkZ1NNQjBfaUhOaGN1SXU1RkU4M3VtN0FLNFNPbTVYSUdBelNkSUc1WUhSRXVXWkl0Z2V2bG5VWQ?oc=5)

## Around the world

An asador contest in La Pampa, Argentina, a charity braai competition in South Africa, a churrasco festival in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, and a gastronomy festival in French Guadeloupe followed one another last week. The names differ, yet the way they gather people before the fire is the same. Source: [La Montaña Noticias](https://news.google.?oc=5), [The Citizen](https://news.google.?oc=5), [ABIH-RJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNM1ZjLXZaYTI4RDF4NTAtbWtNd0ZjYzZzc0JhUmo3OS03bk5QblhtMmNaaFgxRTR6QjhDY3pneC1ZeWpmNG9IaU5tbUQ0RzExU19CVVdkM1FPZmNDeHdNaUhpT1gwOGJvbnBkbkFZMkdOVlpkYWhVY0wySDRYeUdUR3BLcUdPazllc2toWWEtNVRNUDBqT212dWItU3JJc3dlMWZDVm0weVFHZ0JkY2hwNQ?oc=5), [France-Antilles](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxNcjRDUWlhZEVTR0xwVUN6aEVsMWVWb1JwdTRaNzdxUU91b0RaUzBBUW8wTF9hNV9fNjZxdTJna1g1V3dSdWg1U3FNMExQMWdEVHl3VGo2UjMyS0pZcXh5XzlabUV2Y0hod2ZzOGtUX0NnWnZqYVRnRUZYTk9uVlRwUmRlTVdoX3lxSTV0YWxBbXhLak8zMVM2MnJvQm1FZVc2Wm5mNkFqV3hJc2pfUnpfOXIwS19xbFlwclhkckFRR0lUV0JmdDRsRG1aUHBfUQ?oc=5)

## Research

A study published in PLOS One in June this year confirmed traces of repeated fire use in deposits dated between about 1.07 and 1.79 million years ago at Wonderwerk Cave in South Africa. The researchers identified these traces through luminescence, in which burned bone glows red under blue light. They added, however, that these bones alone cannot establish that early humans cooked routinely. Archaeological dating has moved one step closer to the view that finds the origin of cooking with fire in Homo erectus. Source: [Archaeology Magazine](https://archaeologymag.com/2026/06/early-humans-used-fire-in-wonderwerk-cave/)

## 競技バーベキュー

米国テネシー州リンチバーグ（Lynchburg）で開かれた第37回ジャック・ダニエル・ワールドチャンピオンシップ招待バーベキュー（Jack Daniel's World Championship Invitational Barbecue）で、カナダ・カルガリー（Calgary）のジャニス・スメラ（Janice Smella）率いるスメラキュー（Smellaque）チームが1位に輝いた。今回が3度目の挑戦だった。米国南部の聖地と呼ばれる大会の頂点に国境の向こうのチームが立ったことは、競技バーベキューがすでに一国の伝統を越え、国際競技へ移りつつあることを示している。 原文 : [CTV News](https://www.ctvnews.ca/calgary/article/canadian-pitmaster-takes-home-top-prize-in-prestigious-barbecue-competition-in-tennessee/)

10月15日から18日までインディアナポリス（Indianapolis）で開かれたワールド・フード・チャンピオンシップ（World Food Championships）には、35以上の州と14か国から400を超えるチームが参加し、賞金総額は40万ドルを超えた。バーベキュー部門はインディアナ州カーメル（Carmel）のジョーダン・デイビス（Jordan Davis）、ライブファイア部門はオランダ・ユトレヒト（Utrecht）のアディ・メルクマン（Adi Melkman）が優勝した。バーガー部門の優勝は東京の高野帯刀（Tatewaki Takano）に渡った。火を扱う部門の頂点に欧州とアジアの名が並んだことは、この競技が米国内の祭りから世界共通の種目へと広がる過程である。10部門の優勝者は2027年春のファイナルテーブル（Final Table）で最終タイトルを争う。 原文 : [PR Newswire](https://www.webull.com/news/15775408026496000)

## 人材育成

テキサスでは高校生のバーベキューチームが州大会出場をかけた競争を続けている。テンプル高校（Temple High）とカッパラス・コーブ（Copperas Cove）のチームが11月13日、州大会出場を伝えた。学校が火の前の技術を正式な競技の言葉で教えることは、プロバーベキューアー（Pro Barbecuer）が教育体系の中で育ちうることの最も具体的な証拠である。 原文 : [Killeen Daily Herald](https://news.google.?oc=5)、[Copperas Cove Leader Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQTXU2eGxubDkzY3ZqeDhWbXZIbGNsWGg2NDY1cEctVU54WmZuaTlVTER0eFNLQW04UGNjVS02ZFFReDlNUldMVFVLR2RldTlnVlk5bEN1WUpublJpNnRsZFlkaHFFQ0tVaWZYWk1RT2UzZ0ZZN1UzbGkwZHJ6WU5NMjBEOEFldHBS?oc=5)

## バーベキュー産業

ペレットグリルの代表的企業トレーガー（Traeger）は11月4日、第3四半期決算を発表した。総売上高は40.4%減の7,470万ドル、グリル売上高は48.1%減の3,970万ドルだった。経営陣は、第3四半期から持ち越した出荷とロウズ（Lowe's）での販売拡大により、第4四半期には売上が再び伸びると見込んでいる。パンデミック期に裏庭に積み上がった機器需要が引いたあとで、産業は機械をさらに売ることよりも、火をおこす理由を改めてつくることを考えるべき局面に入った。 原文 : [Business Wire](https://finviz.com/news/416010/traeger-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-2026-results)

## アジア

中国のバーベキュー市場は成長と淘汰を同時に経験している。紅餐産業研究院（红餐产业研究院）によれば、2025年の中国バーベキュー（烧烤）市場規模は2,680億元で4.3%増え、2026年には2,800億元を超える見通しだ。しかし2026年2月時点の店舗数は40万9千店に減った。中国は世界のバーベキュー機器の主要な生産拠点であり、広東と河南などに産業集積地が形成されている。来年5月の広州AOBE 2027が機器産業のただ中で開かれる理由がここに読み取れる。 原文 : [澎湃新闻](https://m.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_32862655)

韓国では秋の祭りが続いた。10月29日から11月1日まで洪州城一帯で開かれた2026洪城グローバル・バーベキュー・フェスティバルは、韓牛と韓豚の割引販売、セルフ炭火焼き体験などを行った。鎮安高原キムチポッサム祭りでも黒豚バーベキューが地域の食の中心に立った。韓国のバーベキュー祭りがまだ畜産物の消費促進に重きを置いているとすれば、次の段階は競技と儀礼を備えたスポーツバーベキュー（Sports Barbecue）へ移ることになるだろう。 原文 : [경향신문](https://khan.co.kr/article/202610281056001)、[메트로신문](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFB5LTYtNlFQSTRwWXlkZk1RVmxfZTJfeHdmVWhlYlhmc3VkZ1NNQjBfaUhOaGN1SXU1RkU4M3VtN0FLNFNPbTVYSUdBelNkSUc1WUhSRXVXWkl0Z2V2bG5VWQ?oc=5)

## 世界各地

## 学術

南アフリカのワンダーワーク洞窟（Wonderwerk Cave）で、約107万年前から179万年前の堆積層にわたり繰り返された火の使用の痕跡が確認されたとする研究が、今年6月に『PLOS One』に掲載された。研究チームは、焼けた骨が青い光の下で赤く光る発光現象を用いてその痕跡を見分けた。ただし研究チームは、これらの骨だけで初期人類が日常的に調理していたと断定することはできないと付け加えた。火食の起源をホモ・エレクトス（Homo erectus）に求める見方に、考古学的年代が一歩近づいたことになる。 原文 : [Archaeology Magazine](https://archaeologymag.com/2026/06/early-humans-used-fire-in-wonderwerk-cave/)

## 竞技烧烤

在美国田纳西州林奇堡（Lynchburg）举行的第37届杰克丹尼世界锦标赛邀请赛（Jack Daniel's World Championship Invitational Barbecue）上，由加拿大卡尔加里（Calgary）的贾尼斯·斯梅拉（Janice Smella）率领的Smellaque队夺得第一名。这是她第三次参赛。一支来自国境之外的队伍登上了被誉为美国南方圣地的赛事之巅，这说明竞技烧烤已经越出一国传统，正在走向国际赛事。 原文：[CTV News](https://www.ctvnews.ca/calgary/article/canadian-pitmaster-takes-home-top-prize-in-prestigious-barbecue-competition-in-tennessee/)

10月15日至18日在印第安纳波利斯（Indianapolis）举行的世界美食锦标赛（World Food Championships）吸引了来自35个以上州和14个国家的400多支队伍，奖金总额超过40万美元。烧烤组冠军为印第安纳州卡梅尔（Carmel）的乔丹·戴维斯（Jordan Davis），明火组冠军为荷兰乌得勒支（Utrecht）的阿迪·梅尔克曼（Adi Melkman）。汉堡组冠军由日本东京的高野带刀（Tatewaki Takano）获得。欧洲与亚洲的名字登上用火项目之巅，标志着这项赛事正从美国国内的节庆扩展为世界共通的项目。十个组别的冠军将于2027年春季的总决赛（Final Table）争夺最终头衔。 原文：[PR Newswire](https://www.webull.com/news/15775408026496000)

## 人才培养

在得克萨斯州，高中烧烤队仍在为州赛资格展开角逐。坦普尔高中（Temple High）与科珀拉斯科夫（Copperas Cove）的队伍于11月13日宣布晋级州赛。学校以正式竞赛的语言传授火前技艺，这是职业烧烤师（Pro Barbecuer）能够在教育体系中培养出来的最具体的证据。 原文：[Killeen Daily Herald](https://news.google.?oc=5)、[Copperas Cove Leader Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQTXU2eGxubDkzY3ZqeDhWbXZIbGNsWGg2NDY1cEctVU54WmZuaTlVTER0eFNLQW04UGNjVS02ZFFReDlNUldMVFVLR2RldTlnVlk5bEN1WUpublJpNnRsZFlkaHFFQ0tVaWZYWk1RT2UzZ0ZZN1UzbGkwZHJ6WU5NMjBEOEFldHBS?oc=5)

## 烧烤产业

颗粒烤炉代表企业Traeger于11月4日公布第三季度业绩。总营收下降40.4%，至7,470万美元；烤炉营收下降48.1%，至3,970万美元。管理层预计，在第三季度递延出货与劳氏（Lowe's）渠道扩张的带动下，第四季度营收将恢复增长。疫情期间堆积在后院的设备需求退潮之后，产业已进入一个新阶段：与其多卖机器，不如重新创造点燃炉火的理由。 原文：[Business Wire](https://finviz.com/news/416010/traeger-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-2026-results)

## 亚洲

中国烧烤市场正同时经历增长与洗牌。据红餐产业研究院数据，2025年中国烧烤市场规模达到2,680亿元，同比增长4.3%，预计2026年将突破2,800亿元。然而截至2026年2月，门店数量已降至40.9万家。中国是全球烧烤设备的重要生产基地，已在广东、河南等地形成产业集群。明年5月的广州AOBE 2027之所以在设备产业的腹地举办，原因由此可见。 原文：[澎湃新闻](https://m.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_32862655)

在韩国，秋季节庆接连举行。10月29日至11月1日在洪州城一带举办的2026洪城全球烧烤节，设有韩牛与韩猪折扣销售、自助炭火烧烤体验等项目。在镇安高原泡菜包肉节上，黑猪烧烤同样成为当地美食的焦点。如果说韩国的烧烤节目前仍侧重于促进畜产品消费，那么下一步将是迈向具备竞技与仪式的体育烧烤（Sports Barbecue）。 原文：[경향신문](https://khan.co.kr/article/202610281056001)、[메트로신문](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTFB5LTYtNlFQSTRwWXlkZk1RVmxfZTJfeHdmVWhlYlhmc3VkZ1NNQjBfaUhOaGN1SXU1RkU4M3VtN0FLNFNPbTVYSUdBelNkSUc1WUhSRXVXWkl0Z2V2bG5VWQ?oc=5)

## 学术

今年6月发表于《PLOS One》的一项研究，在南非奇迹洞（Wonderwerk Cave）距今约107万年至179万年的沉积层中，确认了反复用火的痕迹。研究团队利用烧过的骨头在蓝光下发出红光的发光现象辨识出这些痕迹。不过研究团队补充说，仅凭这些骨头还不能断定早期人类已经日常烹饪。将火食起源追溯到直立人（Homo erectus）的观点，在考古年代上又向前迈进了一步。 原文：[Archaeology Magazine](https://archaeologymag.com/2026/06/early-humans-used-fire-in-wonderwerk-cave/)
